name: Piloos Sheet
description: Open, read and edit Excel (.xlsx) files: cells and formulas (XLOOKUP, FILTER, SORT, LET…), number formats, conditional formatting, filters, tables, pivot tables, charts, pictures and shapes, named ranges, sheet protection and printing. Works on phone, tablet and computer, keeps a draft of your edits and works offline.
